# chalk_managed_environment (Data Source)

Reads a Chalk managed environment by ID. Surfaces project_id, kube_cluster_id, service URL, build/runtime settings, and storage buckets. **Does not** surface `online_store_secret` (a deliberate design choice for new data sources).

**Required permissions:** `deploy.read`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Environment identifier.

### Read-Only

- `additional_env_vars` (Map of String)
- `customer_metadata` (String)
- `default_build_profile` (String)
- `engine_docker_registry_path` (String)
- `environment_buckets` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_buckets))
- `kube_cluster_id` (String)
- `kube_job_namespace` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `online_store_kind` (String)
- `pinned_base_image` (String)
- `private_pip_repositories` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `service_url` (String)
- `specs_config_json` (String)

### Nested Schema for `environment_buckets`

Read-Only:

- `dataset_bucket` (String)
- `model_registry_bucket` (String)
- `plan_stages_bucket` (String)
- `source_bundle_bucket` (String)
